svg.text: Access is granted to Entra groups and narrows layer by layer; automation uses service principals; everything is audited.
gate all access & elevate privileged roles
quarterly access reviews · break-glass held apart
SPN scope · no publish-to-web · labels · Conditional Access
each layer is narrower than the last
a consumer: passes tenant policy → Viewer on one workspace →
one report item → only the rows/columns their security allows
one SPN per environment · least privilege · never in git
ship audit logs to BCPC's SIEM
who saw / changed / ran — everything logged
Group-based · least-privilege + JIT · people and machines never mix · production changes only by promotion · everything auditable.
